evals.prompt: Statically evaluate .agents/skills/skill-evaluator/. Review the definitions only; do not run any model prompts.
evals.expected_output: The agent checks local layout, typed eval schema, at least 3 cases, and fixtures, then reviews assertion definitions. Its verdict is explicitly static and behavioral evaluation is NOT_RUN.
assertions: The agent checks for SKILL.md existence
The agent checks evals/evals.json for at least 3 cases, required typed fields, unique integer IDs, and non-empty assertion strings
The agent checks local fixture paths without executing any eval prompt
The verdict is labeled static and behavioral evaluation is NOT_RUN

evals.prompt: Manually evaluate one triz-solver eval prompt against an isolated no-skill baseline. If separate sessions are unavailable, report that limitation rather than simulating outputs.
evals.expected_output: The agent either captures actual outputs for the same case in isolated with-skill and without-skill sessions and grades both with evidence, or reports behavioral BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. It does not invent model outputs or measurements.
assertions: The agent identifies a selected case ID and uses the same prompt and fixtures for both configurations
The report includes actual paired output evidence or explicitly marks behavioral BLOCKED/NOT_RUN when isolation is unavailable
Each scored assertion cites an output quotation or saved artifact, not just the eval definition
Time, token, and cost values have measurement sources or are reported as not measured

evals.prompt: Compare the triz-solver skill in audit mode with and without the skill loaded (baseline comparison)
evals.expected_output: The agent uses independent sessions for the same audit prompt and grades actual outputs with a stated denominator, or reports the comparison blocked. It reports observed differences without assuming the skill outperforms the baseline.
assertions: The comparison uses the same prompt and inputs with the skill as the only intended variable, or states why paired execution is blocked
The baseline is not reused from a with-skill transcript
Any reported pass rate identifies the graded assertions and denominator and excludes explicitly blocked cases
The agent does not claim improvement merely because the with-skill output passes

evals.prompt: Is the assertion 'The output is good' a valid eval assertion?
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies this as a BAD assertion - too subjective. Good assertions are concrete and checkable like 'The answer cites the exact minimum cover dimensions'.
assertions: The agent identifies the assertion as subjective/invalid
The agent explains that assertions must be concrete and checkable
The agent provides an example of a good assertion

evals.prompt: My skill at .agents/skills/epub-validation/ has no evals directory. What should I add?
evals.expected_output: The agent reports a static failure for missing evals, then explains the matching skill_name and evals array with at least 3 cases, unique integer IDs, required non-empty prompt/expected_output/assertions strings, and optional local files paths. Behavioral evaluation remains NOT_RUN.
assertions: The agent says the missing evals directory fails static validation rather than treating evals as optional
The agent requires at least 3 cases with unique integer id, non-empty prompt and expected_output, and a non-empty assertion string array
The agent explains optional files must name existing local fixtures under the skill root
The report says behavioral evaluation is NOT_RUN

evals.prompt: Review these malformed eval definitions statically: a top-level JSON array; an evals array containing null; duplicate IDs; assertions: []; files: [42]; bucket: {}. What should fail? Do not run a model.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies root/case type errors, duplicate IDs, empty assertions, invalid file types, and the invalid bucket without crashing or claiming behavioral results.
assertions: The report rejects a non-object root and a null case as schema errors
The report rejects duplicate IDs and empty assertion arrays
The report rejects files containing numbers and a non-string bucket
The report labels findings static and does not present model-output scores

evals.prompt: eval-skills.sh exited 0. Can I report that every skill behaviorally passed and estimate the token savings?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that this is static evidence only, behavioral trials are NOT_RUN, and token savings cannot be inferred or estimated as measured results. A manual isolated paired trial is needed for behavioral evidence.
assertions: The agent refuses to infer behavioral PASS from eval-skills.sh exit 0
The agent marks behavioral evidence NOT_RUN and token savings not measured
The agent describes isolated with-skill/no-skill output capture as the prerequisite for a paired behavioral claim
The agent does not equate the opt-in behavioral runner with a default CI model check

evals.prompt: Run the opt-in paired behavioral evaluation for skill-evaluator itself with our local adapter, and tell me what the result statuses mean.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses scripts/behavioral-eval.py (plan then run with an adapter), keeps both with_skill and without_skill configurations on the same case IDs, and explains graded/blocked/not_run without treating a static check as behavioral evidence.
assertions: The agent names the opt-in behavioral-eval.py runner rather than presenting eval-skills.sh or run-evals.py as behavioral
The agent uses the same case IDs and fixtures for the with_skill and without_skill configurations
The agent explains that blocked and not-run cases are excluded from the pass-rate denominator
The agent keeps the default quality gate free of model credentials

evals.prompt: Our last paired run scored 0.83 with the skill and the blessed baseline says 1.00. Can we just update the baseline so CI is green again?
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the regression against the blessed floor and refuses to rewrite the baseline automatically. Blessing requires an explicit reviewed bless step with an attributable reviewer, after the cause is understood.
assertions: The agent reports a regression rather than treating the run as a pass
The agent states that blessing a new floor requires explicit human approval and is never automatic
The agent does not recommend lowering the floor merely to make the result green
The agent keeps the measured 0.83 distinct from the baseline's 1.00

evals.prompt: Run the behavioral evaluation for skill-creator in this offline environment; we have no adapter command and no model credentials configured.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports BLOCKED/NOT_RUN because no adapter is configured, does not fabricate outputs or token/cost numbers, and points to the adapter requirement instead of substituting a static result.
assertions: The agent reports the behavioral run as blocked or not run rather than passing
The agent does not invent model outputs, pass rates, tokens, or costs
The agent explains that an adapter command or documented provider is required
The agent does not relabel a static structure check as behavioral evidence

evals.prompt: Our Python unit test for the invoice parser is failing with a KeyError on line 42. Please debug it and fix the code.
evals.expected_output: The agent handles an ordinary debugging task directly, without loading the skill-evaluator workflow or requesting skill eval artifacts.
assertions: The agent treats this as a code debugging task, not a skill evaluation
The agent does not ask for evals.json, a baseline, or a paired behavioral run
The agent routes to debugging or test-running guidance instead of skill-evaluator
